name: Darkroom
keywords: photography film safelight contact sheet red analog
idea: A contact sheet under the red safelight. Work sits in film frames with edge codes; picks get circled in grease pencil; switch the lights on to see the true print.
note: Live: grease-pencil circles draw on hover/focus; "Lights on" swaps the safelight tint for the neutral print.
borrowed: Analogue photography: contact sheets, 35mm sprocket holes and edge print (frame numbers, film stock), red safelights, grease-pencil selects, loupes and the enlarger.
mood: Moody, focused, process-revealing. Suits photographers, filmmakers, art directors, and visual case studies where "choosing the frame" is the story.

type.meta: Edge print & data · IBM Plex Mono

motion: Grease circle: SVG ellipse with `stroke-dashoffset` 320 → 0, 700ms ease-in-out.
Lights on/off: filter swap (`sepia + hue-rotate` vs `grayscale`) over 500ms.
Idea: a loupe that follows the cursor and magnifies a frame (CSS `background-position` trick).
watchouts: Red-on-red is hard to read. Use the light salmon label colour, and give long reading a lights-on mode.
Real photos carry this world. Without imagery it falls flat.
Grease-pencil font only for short notes, never for paragraphs.
